lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I've got something good for you!
Sorry, but I'm stuffed.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, I wasn't talking about food.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: But if you want to try my food so badly,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: you can just let me know!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Just say the word, Commander,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and I'll send you a special lunchbox ^__^
No, I'm honestly quite full.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Are you saying that because you're worried about inconveniencing me?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's okay, really ^__^

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Nothing makes me happier than making something delicious for you, Commander!
... Anyway, what was it that you wanted to tell me?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Surely you haven't forgotten about my specialty in full-body massages, have you?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: After all, you've been on the receiving end more times than I can count!
Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The thing about full body massages, though, is that

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: they require specific oils and a comfortable place to lie down.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: There's a bunch of stuff to get ready,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so it's quite a hassle...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So, I've been in the library for the past few days,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: researching on an ancient method for promoting blood circulation

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: that was widely used on the surface in the past!
Go on...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can tell you that it involves needles.
As in those used for sewing?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Those needles are also used in traditional Eastern medicine.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Have you ever heard about

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: those energy points in a human body?
I have.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: If you insert needles in those spots and stimulate them,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: you'll be amazed!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It dramatically increases your blood flow

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and alleviates both stiffness and lethargy!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So, I wanted to try it out on you straight away!
Do you know how?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The books didn't specify the size of the needle,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so I figured the bigger, the better.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That's why, I've got a needle here thick enough to split rock!
Don't you think it's dangerous?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm... I guess jabbing someone with this might be a tad dangerous.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Come to think of it, when I tried to test it out on Eunhwa,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: she told me off and screamed that I was trying to kill her.
I think you ought to learn the procedure in detail first.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I guess so...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Okay, Commander!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll hit the books real quick so that I can improve your blood flow sooner! ^__^
